name: cache-clock
description: A CACHE band above the prompt: how long the prompt cache stays warm, how much of the last request it served, and what rewriting it would cost (estimate); a Compact button and /cache-clock.

band.title: CACHE band above the prompt
band.description: on: the CACHE row and its toast; off: no row and no toast (/cache-clock status and compact still work). /cache-clock on|off overrides this.

cacheMinutes.title: Prompt-cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: 60: this account's 1-hour prompt-cache TTL (default). 5: the 5-minute TTL, which applies when usage runs on overage.
